fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay, with no additional validity needed.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe ser válido durante toda tu estancia, sin necesidad de validez adicional.
entry.quote: Your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay. No additional period of validity is needed.

entry.en: Border control requires certificates proving yellow fever and polio vaccinations.
entry.es: El control fronterizo exige certificados que prueben las vacunas contra la fiebre amarilla y la polio.
entry.quote: you must have certificates to prove you’ve had: - a yellow fever vaccination, due to a risk of yellow fever transmission - a polio vaccine, due to the risk of polio transmission

entry.en: Arriving travellers may face enhanced health screening because of the Ebola outbreak centred in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
entry.es: Los viajeros que lleguen pueden ser sometidos a controles sanitarios reforzados por el brote de ébola centrado en la República Democrática del Congo.
entry.quote: Travellers arriving in the Republic of Congo may be subject to enhanced health screening measures due to the ongoing Ebola outbreak centred in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

entry.en: Anything prohibited or subject to tax or duty must be declared at customs.
entry.es: Todo lo prohibido o sujeto a impuestos o aranceles debe declararse en la aduana.
entry.quote: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel within 50km of the Central African Republic border in Likouala Region.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a menos de 50 km de la frontera con la República Centroafricana en la región de Likouala.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel within 50km of the Republic of Congo-Central African Republic (CAR) border in Likouala Region.

safety.en: Live conflict in the Pool Region has not been reported since a 2017 ceasefire, but violent clashes could arise again with little or no notice.
safety.es: No se ha informado de conflicto activo en la región de Pool desde un alto el fuego en 2017, pero podrían surgir choques violentos con poco o ningún aviso.
safety.quote: Live conflict has not been reported since both parties signed a ceasefire agreement in 2017. Violent clashes could arise again with little or no notice in response to political events.

safety.en: Opportunistic crime such as pickpocketing has been reported, particularly in Brazzaville and Pointe Noire, and criminals may target foreigners.
safety.es: Se han notificado delitos oportunistas como carterismo, sobre todo en Brazzaville y Pointe Noire, y los delincuentes pueden dirigirse a extranjeros.
safety.quote: There have been reports of crime, particularly opportunistic crime such as pickpocketing, particularly in Brazzaville and Pointe Noire, and criminals may target foreigners.

safety.en: Demonstrations happen occasionally and have become violent in the past.
safety.es: Las manifestaciones ocurren de vez en cuando y en el pasado se han vuelto violentas.
safety.quote: Demonstrations happen occasionally. In the past, demonstrations have become violent.

safety.en: Vehicle checkpoints are frequent and can be poorly marked.
safety.es: Los controles de vehículos son frecuentes y pueden estar mal señalizados.
safety.quote: There are frequent vehicle checkpoints in the Republic of Congo, which can be poorly marked.

safety.en: Corruption in the Congolese police is widespread.
safety.es: La corrupción en la policía congoleña está muy extendida.
safety.quote: Corruption in the Congolese police is widespread.

health.en: The likelihood of getting malaria is very high if effective preventative medication is not taken.
health.es: La probabilidad de contraer malaria es muy alta si no se toma medicación preventiva eficaz.
health.quote: The likelihood of getting malaria is very high if effective preventative medication is not taken.

health.en: Tap water is not drinkable, if it is even running at all.
health.es: El agua del grifo no es potable, si es que siquiera sale.
health.quote: Tap water is not drinkable, if it's even running at all.

health.en: Medical facilities are limited, particularly in rural areas, and medical evacuation is likely to be necessary for all but the most basic treatments.
health.es: Los servicios médicos son limitados, sobre todo en zonas rurales, y es probable que haga falta evacuación médica salvo para los tratamientos más básicos.
health.quote: Medical facilities in the country are limited, particularly in rural areas. Medical evacuation is likely to be necessary for all but the most basic treatments.

health.en: Travel and medical insurance should cover treatment abroad and repatriation, including costly air ambulance evacuation.
health.es: El seguro de viaje y médico debe cubrir el tratamiento en el extranjero y la repatriación, incluida la costosa evacuación en ambulancia aérea.
health.quote: Make sure you have adequate travel and medical insurance to cover the cost of any medical treatment abroad and repatriation

help.en: There is no central emergency number in the Republic of Congo, and crimes can be reported to local police on 06 665 4804.
help.es: No hay un número central de emergencias en la República del Congo, y los delitos pueden denunciarse a la policía local al 06 665 4804.
help.quote: There’s no central number for emergency services in the Republic of Congo. You can report crimes to local police on 06 665 4804.

getting_in.en: The main airport is Maya-Maya (BZV) in Brazzaville.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto principal es Maya-Maya (BZV), en Brazzaville.
getting_in.quote: Maya-Maya Airport (BZV IATA), ☏ +242 820-996. The main airport of the country is in Brazzaville.

getting_in.en: Passenger and VIP ferries run daily between Brazzaville and Kinshasa roughly every 2 hours between 8AM and 3PM.
getting_in.es: Los transbordadores de pasajeros y VIP operan a diario entre Brazzaville y Kinshasa aproximadamente cada 2 horas entre las 8:00 y las 15:00.
getting_in.quote: Passenger and VIP ferries operate daily between Brazzaville and Kinshasa roughly every 2 hours between 8AM and 3PM.

getting_in.en: A valid visa for both countries is required for the Brazzaville-Kinshasa ferry in either direction.
getting_in.es: Se requiere un visado válido para ambos países en el transbordador Brazzaville-Kinshasa en cualquier sentido.
getting_in.quote: A valid visa for both countries is required in either direction.

getting_in.en: Barges follow the Congo and then the Oubangui rivers up to Bangui.
getting_in.es: Las barcazas siguen los ríos Congo y luego Oubangui hasta Bangui.
getting_in.quote: Barges follow the Congo, then the Oubangui, rivers right up to Bangui.

getting_around.en: Taxis have no meter, so you must negotiate the fare before going anywhere.
getting_around.es: Los taxis no tienen taxímetro, así que debes negociar la tarifa antes de ir a cualquier sitio.
getting_around.quote: Taxis in the Republic of the Congo do not have a meter, which means you have to negotiate for a reasonable fare before going anywhere.

getting_around.en: The Congo-Ocean Railway reopened between Pointe-Noire and Brazzaville in April 2023 and is scheduled to take 16 hours for the 502 km journey.
getting_around.es: El ferrocarril Congo-Océano reabrió entre Pointe-Noire y Brazzaville en abril de 2023 y tarda según el horario 16 horas en los 502 km.
getting_around.quote: The Congo-Ocean Railway (COR, or CFCO) re-opened between Pointe-Noire and Brazzaville in Apr 2023 after a 7-year closure. It is scheduled to take 16 hours to complete the 502 kilometres (312 mi) journey.

getting_around.en: Shared taxis and minibuses run on an ad hoc basis between towns and villages.
getting_around.es: Los taxis compartidos y minibuses circulan de forma improvisada entre pueblos y ciudades.
getting_around.quote: shared taxis and minibuses run on an ad hoc basis between towns and villages

getting_around.en: A trip from the airport to the city centre in Brazzaville costs 3000 CFA.
getting_around.es: Ir del aeropuerto al centro de Brazzaville cuesta 3000 CFA.
getting_around.quote: If you want to go to the city centre from the airport, it will cost you 3000 CFA.

money.en: The currency is the Central African CFA franc (FCFA, ISO code XAF).
money.es: La moneda es el franco CFA de África Central (FCFA, código ISO XAF).
money.quote: The currency of the country is the Central African CFA franc, denoted FCFA (ISO currency code: XAF).

money.en: The U.S. dollar is not widely accepted.
money.es: El dólar estadounidense no se acepta ampliamente.
money.quote: The U.S. dollar is not widely accepted.

money.en: All Ecobank ATMs take Mastercard and Visa cards for cash withdrawal.
money.es: Todos los cajeros de Ecobank aceptan tarjetas Mastercard y Visa para retirar efectivo.
money.quote: All Ecobank ATMs in the Republic of the Congo take Mastercard and Visa card for cash withdrawal.

money.en: All business is conducted in cash, small change is very scarce, and torn or taped banknotes should not be accepted.
money.es: Todos los negocios se hacen en efectivo, el cambio menudo escasea mucho y no se deben aceptar billetes rotos o con cinta.
money.quote: All business is conducted in cash. Small change is very scarce and hard to come by. Do not accept torn or taped banknotes.

etiquette.en: Racial tension and discrimination against white travelers is not uncommon, so they should take care.
etiquette.es: La tensión racial y la discriminación contra viajeros blancos no son raras, por lo que deben tener cuidado.
etiquette.quote: White travelers should take care while travelling in the Republic. Racial tension and discrimination is not uncommon here

connectivity.en: The text lists three mobile operators: MTN, CelTel (now Zain) and Warid.
connectivity.es: El texto menciona tres operadores móviles: MTN, CelTel (ahora Zain) y Warid.
connectivity.quote: You can talk to your loved ones using any of the three mobile operators MTN, CelTel (now Zain), or Warid.
